not-yet.response: I can reuse my England tenancy rules in Wales.
not-yet.why: Wrong jurisdiction; current residence does not determine the new property’s housing guidance.

assisted.response: After an assessor points out the border, I use Welsh Government renting-homes guidance.
assisted.why: Correct route chosen after solving assistance.

independent.response: I keep guidance separate by property location, use Welsh occupation-contract sources for Wales, compare full upfront/ongoing costs and ask about missing terms. I do not declare legal validity from an advert.
independent.why: Correct jurisdiction, verification, financial comparison and legal limits.

advanced.response: If the proposed property changes nation or terms change, I recheck scope and costs, seek the relevant qualified advice and keep the next step reversible.
advanced.why: Re-evaluates jurisdiction and feasibility when the context changes.
